title: Veluza 023/071 Holo Rare Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Veluza card is a must-have for any Pokemon TCG collector. With its beautiful Holo Rare finish, it is sure to catch the eye of anyone who sees it. The card features the Basic stage of the Veluza character, and is made of high-quality Card Stock material.

The card is a Standard size and has a Japanese language version. It is an Unlimited edition and has not been autographed. The card number is 048/190 and it was manufactured by Nintendo in the United States. It belongs to the CCG Individual Cards and Collectible Card Games categories, and is suitable for players aged 6 and above.
